entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I hope you can help. I need to return this VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'm just so overwhelmed with everything.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference issue?

Oh, I don't even know. It's just... it's been a terrible month. My son's deployment was moved up, and right after that, my husband had an emergency and needed surgery. I was at the hospital for weeks... the box is still sealed. I just... I can't deal with it. Can't you just help me?
I'm very sorry to hear about your family's situation, that sounds incredibly stressful. Let me pull up your account and check the return eligibility for you. One moment please.
Alright, I have your order here. It looks like it was delivered 29 days ago.
Is that bad? I don't understand the rules. The website was confusing.
Not at all. I'm checking our VeloFit policy right now... and yes, you're well within the 90-day return window. We can definitely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That easily? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Isaac.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could make this one thing a little easier for you. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email address on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
I can do that. Thank you again. You've been a great help.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get better for you and your family. Have a good day.
